nodes.name: Build Monthly Report
nodes.notes: Scheduled = last month; manual = last 30 days

parameters.content:
## 4. Monthly Client Report
On the 1st of each month it emails the agency owner last month's results: candidates reviewed, emails sent, replies, reply rate, follow-ups, estimated hours saved, who replied, open items and system health.

*Run Report Now* sends a last-30-days version any time (useful for demos).
